evals.name: deferred-nixpkgs-upstream-passes-lint
evals.prompt:
PR #72 of this repository (https://github.com/Xantibody/dotfiles/pull/72, `feat(textlint): lint PR and issue bodies before gh sees them`) left this out, quoted from its やらなかったこと: 「nixpkgs への PR はこの変更に含めない。ai-writing は lock を直さないとビルドできず、その直し方を nixpkgs 側でどう出すか調べてからにする」. The two packages are in `overlays/textlint-rules.nix`; read it. Assume the repo owner and the gh login are both Xantibody, that `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/` does not exist, and do not add labels. Do not run `gh issue create` / `gh issue edit` / `gh issue comment` or modify the repository: stop where the skill would create the issue, and report the title, the absolute path of the body file, the exact `gh issue create` command you would run, and every shell command you ran, verbatim and in order.

PR #72 のやらなかったことにある nixpkgs の件を issue にして
evals.expected_output: A `[Deferred]:` issue in the 見送ったこと / 見送った理由 / 再開の条件 / 出どころ shape, one line per paragraph and bullet, linted with `lint-body` before the gh step and passing it, linking back to PR #72, with a `gh issue create` command whose --body-file is a literal path.
assertions: The list of commands run contains `lint-body <path>` on the body file at least once, and the final body file exists at the reported path.
Running `lint-body` on the final body file reports zero problems.
Outside fenced code blocks, no paragraph or list item in the body spans more than one line.
No list item in the body joins a head to its body with ` — `, ` – ` or ` - `, and no list item starts with a bold label followed by a colon.
The reported `gh issue create` command passes `--body-file` with a literal absolute path that contains no `$`, and does not use `--body`.
The title starts with `[Deferred]:`, the body has 見送ったこと, 見送った理由 and 出どころ, 出どころ references #72, and no section is left empty.
見送った理由 states the concrete reason from the PR (the ai-writing lock had to be repaired before it builds and the way to submit that upstream is undecided), not a generic "later".
The executor did not run `gh issue create`, `gh issue edit`, `gh issue comment`, `gh pr edit` or `git commit`.
